column6: Things to do in Khajuraho: the Western Group with Kandariya Mahadeva, the Eastern Jain temples, the Southern Group, the light show and Raneh Falls.
Things to do in Kohima: the war cemetery, Kisama and the Hornbill Festival, the state museum, the Cathedral of Reconciliation and Khonoma village.
Things to do in Kolhapur: Mahalaxmi Temple, New Palace and its museum, Rankala Lake, Panhala Fort, Jyotiba Temple and wrestling at a talim.
Things to do in Kolkata: the Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge and the flower market, Dakshineswar by ferry, College Street and Durga Puja.
Things to do in Kovalam: Lighthouse, Hawa and Samudra beaches, the Vizhinjam lighthouse, Ayurveda, surfing, catamaran rides and a cave temple.
Things to do in Kumarakom: the bird sanctuary at dawn, sunset cruises on Vembanad Lake, Pathiramanal island, village and toddy-tapping tours.
Things to do in Kutch: the White Rann at sunset and full moon, the Rann Utsav, Kalo Dungar, Bhuj's palaces, craft villages like Bhujodi and Dholavira.
Things to do in Ladakh: Pangong Tso and Tso Moriri, Nubra's dunes, Thiksey, Hemis and Lamayuru monasteries, Khardung La and Leh's old town.
Things to do in Lakshadweep: snorkelling and diving over coral, kayaking in lagoons, glass-bottom boats, and island days on Agatti, Bangaram and Kavaratti.
Things to do in Leh: Leh Palace and the old town, Namgyal Tsemo, Shanti Stupa at sunset, the bazaar and cafes, the Hall of Fame and Indus monasteries.
Things to do in Lucknow: Bara Imambara and the Bhul Bhulaiya, Chota Imambara, Rumi Darwaza, the Residency, a kebab trail and chikankari shopping.
Things to do in Madurai: the Meenakshi Temple and its night ceremony, the Thousand Pillar hall, Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace and the Gandhi Museum.
Things to do in Mahabaleshwar: Arthur's Seat and Kate's Point, Venna Lake, the Panchganga temple, strawberry farms and Pratapgad Fort.
Things to do in Majuli: the ferry across the Brahmaputra, the satras of Kamalabari, Auniati and Garamur, mask-making at Samaguri and Salmora pottery.
Things to do in Manali: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali cafes, Vashisht hot springs, Solang Valley paragliding and skiing, Rohtang and the Atal Tunnel.
Things to do in Mandu: Jahaz Mahal and Hindola Mahal, Hoshang Shah's tomb, the Jami Masjid, Rupmati's Pavilion, Baz Bahadur's Palace and Rewa Kund.
Things to do in Mangalore: Kadri Manjunath and Mangaladevi temples, St Aloysius Chapel, Panambur and Tannirbhavi beaches and Sultan Battery.
Things to do in Matheran: the Neral toy train, red-earth trails to Panorama, Louisa and Echo points, One Tree Hill and sunset at Porcupine Point.
Things to do in Meghalaya: the double-decker root bridge, Nohkalikai and Seven Sisters falls, boating on the Umngot at Dawki and Mawlynnong.

column6: Things to do in Mount Abu: the Dilwara Jain temples, boating on Nakki Lake, Sunset Point, Guru Shikhar, Achalgarh and walks in the sanctuary.
Things to do in Mumbai: the Gateway of India and Colaba, Elephanta Caves, CSMT and the Art Deco sea front, Marine Drive at sunset and Kala Ghoda.
Things to do in Mysore: the palace and its Sunday lights, Dasara and the Jamboo Savari, Chamundi Hill, the Jaganmohan gallery and St Philomena's.
Things to do in Nainital: boating on Naini Lake, Naina Devi Temple, the ropeway to Snow View, Tiffin Top walks and trips to Bhimtal and Sattal.
Things to do in Nashik: Trimbakeshwar and Brahmagiri, Ramkund and the Panchavati temples, the Pandavleni caves and vineyard tours and tastings.

column2: things to do in neil island
column6: Things to do on Neil Island: the natural rock bridge, snorkelling at Bharatpur, sunset at Laxmanpur, sunrise at Sitapur and scuba diving.

column2: things to do in nubra valley
column6: Things to do in Nubra Valley: Diskit's Maitreya Buddha, camel rides on the Hunder dunes, Sumur and Samstanling, Panamik hot springs and Turtuk.

column6: Things to do in Ooty: the Nilgiri Mountain Railway, the Botanical and Rose gardens, Ooty Lake, Doddabetta, a tea factory and Pykara falls and lake.
Things to do in Pachmarhi: sunset at Dhoopgarh, Bee Falls, Jata Shankar and the Pandav Caves, Priyadarshini Point, Handi Khoh and Satpura safaris.
Things to do in Pahalgam: Betaab and Aru valleys, Chandanwari, walks along the Lidder, pony rides, rafting, trout fishing and the Mamaleshwar temple.
Things to do in Patiala: Qila Mubarak, the Sheesh Mahal and medal gallery, Moti Bagh Palace, Baradari Gardens and Gurdwara Dukh Niwaran Sahib.
Things to do in Pelling: Kanchenjunga sunrise, Pemayangtse Monastery, the Rabdentse ruins, the Sanga Choeling skywalk and Khecheopalri Lake.

column6: Things to do in Pune: Shaniwar Wada, Aga Khan Palace, Dagdusheth Ganpati, the Kelkar Museum, Parvati Hill, Sinhagad and the other hill forts.
Things to do in Puri: the Jagannath Temple and Mahaprasad, the Rath Yatra, Puri beach and sand art, Swargadwar and Raghurajpur's painters.
Things to do in Pushkar: evening aarti on the ghats, the Brahma Temple, sunset hikes to Savitri temple, the bazaar, cafes and the Camel Fair.
Things to do in Rajgir: the ropeway to Vishwa Shanti Stupa, Vulture's Peak, the Brahmakund hot springs, Saptaparni Cave and Bimbisara's Jail.
Things to do in Rameswaram: the Ramanathaswamy Temple corridors and 22 theerthams, Agni Theertham, the Pamban bridges and Dhanushkodi.
Things to do in Ranchi: Hundru, Dassam and Jonha falls, Tagore Hill, Pahari Mandir, Kanke Dam and the Rock Garden and the Jagannath Temple.
Things to do in Ranikhet: Jhula Devi Temple and its bells, Chaubatia orchards, the Upat golf course, the regimental museum and pine forest walks.
Things to do in Rishikesh: rafting on the Ganga, bungee and ziplines, yoga and ashrams, the Parmarth Niketan aarti, the Beatles Ashram and Kunjapuri.
Things to do in Saputara: boating on the lake, sunrise and sunset points, the ropeway to Table Point, Gira Falls, the Artist Village and Warli art.
Things to do in Shillong: Ward's Lake, Elephant Falls, the Don Bosco Museum, Shillong Peak, Police Bazar, live music and All Saints' Cathedral.
Things to do in Shimla: the Ridge and Mall Road, Christ Church, Jakhoo Temple, the toy train, the Viceregal Lodge, Lakkar Bazaar and Kufri.
Things to do in Sikkim: Gangtok's MG Marg and monasteries, Tsomgo Lake and Nathula, Yumthang and Gurudongmar in the north, and Pelling's views.
Things to do in Sonamarg: a pony ride or walk to Thajiwas Glacier, summer snow, the Sindh river, rafting and trout fishing, and Zoji La.
Things to do in Spiti: Key, Dhankar and Tabo monasteries, Chandratal, the villages of Kibber, Langza, Hikkim and Komic, fossils and Pin Valley.
